'''Apartment three hundred seven twelve''' was a safehouse maintained by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] during the onset of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Located on the three hundredth floor of the [[Zorp House]] apartment tower in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], the quarters were secretly occupied by [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]], under provision of GAG [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].

The apartment was filled with art from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] reproduction of ''[[Killik Twilight]]''. Every wall also had at least one mirror, which would allow someone to see the entire apartment with the proper angle, no matter which room they were in. The mirrors would also use optical illusions to make what someone was seeing in them more attractive. Lumiya also had fresh flowers on a table, but they were actually [[nerfscourge]].<ref name="Tempest" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] discovered it while investigating [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]]'s [[Duel in the Fellowship Plaza|death]]. They convinced the [[Zorp House building manager|building manager]] to recite the tower's universal [[Red seven, blue twelve, green zero zero|passcode]] to allow them inside to continue their investigation.
